route_planner.runtime_information_scope: static map topology and the robot's own task-level reference route
route_planner.off_route_repair: bridge from the current cell to the first unfinished reference waypoint, then append the unchanged reference suffix
route_planner.off_route_repair_trigger: first blocked step after local PIBT displacement

admission_controller.hard_capacity_gate: every physical entry commit independently satisfies sum-minus-max capacity
admission_controller.congestion_signal: structural local stall without execution failure, or full physical occupancy
admission_controller.execution_failure_signal: stutter; retain the outstanding eligibility grant

marshalling_solver.algorithm: lower-bound beam search with complete exact fallback

external_semantics.single_shot: agent disappears immediately after reaching its unique goal
external_semantics.lifelong: agent receives the next goal from its fixed per-agent goal sequence immediately after completion
external_semantics.execution: synchronous discrete steps; stochastic command drops retain the acknowledged decision and insert stutter steps
